description: For two well-orders, strict comparison of their types is equivalent to existence of a principal initial-segment embedding.
signature:
Ordinal.type_lt_iff.{u_1} {α β : Type u_1} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop} [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] :
  Ordinal.type r < Ordinal.type s ↔ Nonempty (PrincipalSeg r s)
